name: nebim-v3
title: Nebim V3 (retail ERP)
summary: Nebim V3 retail ERP on SQL Server. Table prefixes: cd = code/master tables, cdXxxDesc = names per language (join on LangCode), pr = properties, tr = transactions. Items are keyed by six columns: ItemTypeCode, ItemCode, ColorCode, ItemDim1Code, ItemDim2Code, ItemDim3Code (ItemTypeCode 1 = product). This is NOT Nebim Winner, an older product with a different schema.
rules: Join every *Desc table on its key AND LangCode (usually 'TR'), or names repeat once per language.
An item is identified by all six key parts (ItemTypeCode, ItemCode, ColorCode, ItemDim1Code, ItemDim2Code, ItemDim3Code); joining on ItemCode alone over-counts variants.
trInvoiceHeader.IsReturn: 0 = sale, 1 = return. Exclude returns from sales totals or subtract them explicitly.
SUM(Qty1 * Price) on trInvoiceLine is gross, before discounts; AllInvoices.Doc_NetAmount is the safer net amount.
Use WITH (NOLOCK) on large transaction tables so the agent never blocks the ERP's writers (reads may then be slightly stale).
Current-account (cari) balances: no verified source in this profile. Ask the customer which table or view their reports use before computing a balance.

tables.name: cdCurrAcc
tables.title: Current account master (cari kart): customers, vendors, stores
columns: Account type ('1' vendor-like, '5' store — likely; other values unverified)

tables.name: cdItemDesc
tables.title: Item names (ürün adı), one row per language

tables.name: ItemInventory
tables.title: Available stock per variant and warehouse (view or table)
tables.notes: Prefer this over summing trStock for stock on hand.

queries.title: Item by barcode
queries.sql: SELECT b.Barcode, d.ItemDescription, b.ItemCode, b.ColorCode, b.ItemDim1Code FROM prItemBarcode b WITH (NOLOCK) JOIN cdItemDesc d ON d.ItemTypeCode = b.ItemTypeCode AND d.ItemCode = b.ItemCode AND d.LangCode = 'TR' WHERE b.Barcode = '8690000000000'

queries.title: Available stock per warehouse for one item
queries.sql: SELECT ItemCode, ColorCode, ItemDim1Code, WarehouseCode, SUM(AvailableInventoryQty1) AS Qty FROM ItemInventory WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ItemCode = 'ITEM-CODE' GROUP BY ItemCode, ColorCode, ItemDim1Code, WarehouseCode

queries.title: Gross sales per customer, last 30 days (returns excluded)
queries.sql: SELECT h.CurrAccCode, cd.CurrAccDescription, SUM(l.Qty1 * l.Price) AS Amount FROM trInvoiceLine l WITH (NOLOCK) JOIN trInvoiceHeader h WITH (NOLOCK) ON h.InvoiceHeaderID = l.InvoiceHeaderID LEFT JOIN cdCurrAccDesc cd ON cd.CurrAccCode = h.CurrAccCode AND cd.CurrAccTypeCode = h.CurrAccTypeCode WHERE h.IsReturn = 0 AND h.InvoiceDate >= DATEADD(day, -30, CAST(GETDATE() AS date)) GROUP BY h.CurrAccCode, cd.CurrAccDescription
